title: Ali the Persian
logline: To cheer a sleepless Caliph, Ali the Persian tells how a stranger claimed his little lunch bag in court, how the two of them swore it held herds, cities and armies, and how the judge simply had it opened.
moral: A simple look at the facts ends a quarrel that no amount of clever argument could; wild claims collapse the moment someone checks.
tone: Light courtroom farce inside a warm bedtime frame: escalating absurdity played straight, a deadpan judge, a quiet punchline of bread, cheese, olives and one lemon.

beats.summary: The Caliph cannot sleep and wants a story to make him laugh.
Ali the Persian arrives and sits before the Caliph; the tale begins.
Plant: one small leather bag of provisions.
A stranger snatches the bag in the market and claims it.
The judge asks the claimant what is inside.
The list goes absurd: tents, rugs, cattle, camels, lions, whole rooms.
Ali, stunned, decides to answer with a bigger exaggeration.
Ali claims a house, a school, a garden, Baghdad, Basra, armies and thousands of witnesses.
The judge runs out of patience: a bottomless sea, or a meeting place for all mankind?
He orders the bag opened; everyone leans in.
Inside: bread, a little cheese, olives and one lemon.
Ali throws the bag at his rival's feet and walks out, leaving the judge with the absurdity.
The Caliph bursts out laughing and rewards Ali.
A simple look inside exposed two unbelievable claims.

actions.action: Thumbs to his chest, chin high, a huge smug smile. The rival's pile droops and his arms fall.
actions.acting: chest gesture, lid 0.4, mouth 'smile'; left pile tips 0.06 rad; stranger sq 0.95.

scenes.summary: The judge's patience runs out. He slams the desk, both piles collapse, and he asks whether this bag is a bottomless sea or a place where all mankind gathers. Then he orders it opened.

camera.notes: Slam on (500, 660, 1.3) with a 5 px panel-only shake at 96.9; hold on the judge with both claimants at the frame edges; 108.3 ease up to (500, 520, 1.2) for his balloon; 114.82 back down; 117.46 pull out to the full court (500, 615, 1.0).

scenes.composition: Judge centre. His balloon (460 x 330) at (500, 300), tail to his head, directly above the bag so the idea hangs over the real thing. Claimants shrink at x 190 and 810.

actions.action: Rises behind the desk and slams both palms down. ENOUGH!
actions.acting: arms up (anticipation from 96.4), slam at 96.9, panel shake; brow +1, mouth open.

actions.action: Burst over the desk: OPEN IT!
actions.acting: Clear of the judge's face, above the bag.

scenes.summary: Ali opens the bag. Everyone leans in. No city, no animal, no army.

actions.acting: walk x 810 to 610 in 1.0 s, footfalls; calm, half smile.

actions.acting: saccades (gazePlan ease 0.07), brows rise, then level.

scenes.summary: What the bag really holds: bread, a little cheese, olives and one lemon, laid out one by one.

actions.action: Hold tight on the cloth so each item gets its own beat.
actions.acting: The three pairs of eyes above follow Ali's hand.

actions.action: Out comes a round flatbread, set down on the cloth. Counter: 1.
actions.acting: lands with a soft squash; three pairs of eyes drop to it.

actions.action: Pinches finger and thumb: just a little.
actions.acting: hand raised, 6 px gap, one eye narrowed (wink half).

actions.action: A tiny wedge of cheese. Counter: 2.

actions.action: Turns the bag upside down and shakes it.

actions.acting: two decaying bounces (hop), roll with rotation; the bag hangs limp in Ali's hand.

scenes.summary: Ali tosses the bag at his rival's feet and walks out, leaving the judge alone with the absurdity of the quarrel.

camera.notes: Cut to the wide (500, 680, 1.1); the bag is tied again in Ali's hand (the food went back in under the cut). From 140.76 a slow push toward the judge (470, 680, 1.6), keeping the stranger and the bag in frame.

actions.action: Looks at the doorway, then at the stranger, then at the bag.

actions.acting: headHold one hand, lid 0.5, gaze [0, 0.05]: the film's one look into the lens.

actions.acting: head drop with a small squash, turban rolls 40 px and rocks (swing); stranger sneak steps.

scenes.summary: Back in the palace: the Caliph explodes with laughter at the ending and rewards Ali with a generous gift.

camera.notes: The tale cloud shrinks back into Ali's head at 144.92 revealing the two-shot (540, 740, 1.35); 2 px panel shake pulses with the first laughs; 152.4 ease to include Ja'far (520, 740, 1.25).

actions.action: The tale cloud shrinks into Ali's head; the Caliph is holding it in, cheeks puffed.
actions.acting: Caliph sq 0.93, lid 0.8, shoulders trembling (tremble 2 px, 8 Hz).

actions.action: He bursts: head back, mouth wide, rocking back on the diwan and slapping the cushion. HA HA HA! The worry scribble pops for good.

actions.action: Ja'far laughs behind his hand, shoulders shaking.
actions.acting: mouthCover, lid 0.6, tremble 1.5 px at 5 Hz, out of phase with the Caliph.

actions.action: Wipes a tear and a second, smaller wave of laughter takes him.
actions.acting: wet eyes, hand to the eye, then a shorter rock (amp halved).

actions.action: Ali mimes the last move of his story: drops an invisible bag and dusts his hands, grinning.
actions.acting: hand opens downward, two brushes; smile, brows up.

actions.action: Bows from his seat, hand on chest.
actions.acting: tip 0.12, lid 0.5, then back up.

actions.action: Still chuckling, waves Ja'far forward.
actions.acting: pointFwd toward Ali, smile, small aftershock laughs.

actions.action: Steps forward carrying a fat purse in both hands.
actions.acting: two steps to x 420 (walk), the purse held low: it is heavy.

actions.acting: reachBoth; hands drop 14 px and recover (settleTo); two glints.

actions.action: Eyes wide at the weight; a coin pops out and he catches it. Behind him the Caliph yawns hugely.
actions.acting: Ali lid 0, mouth o then smile; coin hop arc; Caliph long yawn (mouth open, lid 0.8, stretch sq 1.05).

scenes.summary: The moral as one clean graphic: the quarrel over the small bag ended not by a complicated ruling but by simply looking inside, which exposed two unbelievable claims.

camera.notes: Flat graphic card, camera (500, 615, 1.0); a small zoom to 1.15 on the bag at 162.26; back to 1.0 at 163.7 for the two piles.

scenes.composition: Bag centre (500, 760), drawn 2x. Head-and-shoulder busts of the stranger (x 190, y 900) and Ali (x 810, y 900). Scroll and scale drop in from the top centre (500, 330). Food row under the bag at y 900. Ghost piles rise behind each bust.

scenes.summary: Closing image: the sleepless Caliph has finally fallen asleep, smiling. THE END.

subtitles.ar: لم يستطع الخليفة هارون الرشيد النوم ذات ليلة،|فطلب من وزيره جعفر قصة تضحكه وتخفف عنه الهم.|اقترح جعفر استدعاء رجل يعرف الحكايات الطريفة اسمه علي الفارسي،|فحضر علي وجلس أمام الخليفة.
subtitles.en: One sleepless night Caliph Harun al-Rashid|asked Ja’far for an amusing story.|Ja’far brought Ali the Persian,|a man known for entertaining tales.

subtitles.ar: قال علي إنه سافر يومًا يحمل كيسًا جلديًا صغيرًا فيه زاده.|وبينما كان يشتري من سوق مدينة غريبة،|أمسك به رجل كردي وانتزع الكيس منه،|وادعى أمام الناس أنه صاحبه الحقيقي.
subtitles.en: Ali recalled traveling with a small leather bag of provisions.|At a market,|a Kurdish stranger seized it|and loudly claimed ownership.

subtitles.ar: احتكم الخصمان إلى القاضي،|فسأل المدعي عن محتويات الكيس. بدأ الرجل يعدد أشياء معقولة،|ثم زعم أن فيه خيمتين وبساطين وبقرة وعجلين|وأغنامًا وجمالًا وسباعًا، بل وغرفًا كاملة داخل الكيس الصغير.
subtitles.en: They appeared before a judge,|who asked the claimant to describe the contents.|The man listed tents, rugs, cattle,|camels, wild beasts, and even rooms.

subtitles.ar: صُعق علي من المبالغة، لكنه رد بمبالغة أكبر.|قال إن كيسه يحوي بيتًا قديمًا ومدرسة وحديقة|ومدينة بغداد ومدينة البصرة، وجيوشًا من الجنود،|وآلاف الناس الذين يشهدون أنه ملكه.
subtitles.en: Astonished, Ali retaliated with a grander inventory:|houses, a school, gardens,|Baghdad, Basra, armies,|and thousands of witnesses—all supposedly in his bag.

subtitles.ar: نفد صبر القاضي، وقال إن أحدًا لم يسمع قط ادعاءات بهذه الغرابة.|سأل الرجلين: هل هذا الكيس بحر بلا قرار|أم مكان يجتمع فيه الناس جميعًا؟|ثم أمرهما بفتحه أمام المجلس.
subtitles.en: The judge finally asked|whether this was a bottomless sea|or a place containing all humanity.|He ordered the bag opened before the court.

subtitles.ar: فتح علي الكيس، فلم يجد فيه أحد مدينة ولا حيوانًا ولا جيشًا.|لم يكن داخله إلا خبز وقليل من الجبن وزيتون وحبة ليمون.|ألقى علي الكيس أمام خصمه وانصرف، تاركًا القاضي يواجه سخافة النزاع.
subtitles.en: The bag contained no cities or animals—only|bread, cheese, olives, and a lemon.|Ali dropped it before his rival and walked away.

subtitles.ar: انفجر هارون الرشيد ضاحكًا حين وصل علي إلى نهاية قصته،|وأعطاه هدية سخية.|وهكذا انتهت خصومة الكيس الصغير، لا بحكم معقد،|بل بكشف بسيط فضح ادعاءين لا يمكن تصديقهما.
subtitles.en: Harun al-Rashid laughed heartily at the ending|and rewarded Ali.|A simple inspection|had exposed both men’s absurd claims.

new_assets.name: palaceHall (night option)
new_assets.description: Night lighting for the planned palaceHall: moon and stars in the arches, lit lamps, navy wash.
new_assets.implementation: Add a night 0..1 option to the planned palaceHall: draw skyCycle(ctx, 0.72) clipped to the arch openings, mixHex the wall and floor colours toward NAVY2 by night, draw each lamp with a radial halftone glow (K dots) and a seeded 2 % flicker. Bake once per night value.

new_assets.name: palaceHall (variant courtRoom)
new_assets.description: Plain day court: three arches, centre dais with bench and low desk, deep front floor, blank side walls.
new_assets.implementation: Variant flag on palaceHall: skip carpet, lamps and door; dais as a filled rect x 360..640, y 820..900 with a brush border; bench (rect 200 x 48) and desk (rect 200 x 60, top y 760) as separate draw calls so the judge sits between them; checker floor extended to y 1230.

new_assets.name: marketStreet
new_assets.description: The planned market street with one stall (fruit and bread here).
new_assets.implementation: Flat house fronts (rects with arched doors, awnings as striped quads) baked over sky(day) and ground(); the stall is a separate function (counter, striped awning on two poles, goods as circles) so it can be restocked per story.

new_assets.name: leatherBag
new_assets.description: Small drawstring pouch with open, bulge, limp and strap fields; the star prop of the film.
new_assets.implementation: A rounded sack path (bezier) in brown with red dot shading, a gathered neck and cord; open blends the neck from pinched to an oval mouth with a dark inside; bulge scales the belly; limp lowers and flattens it; strap is a 6 px line to strapTo. Origin at the base centre; supports sq.

new_assets.name: claimTiles
new_assets.description: Seventeen flat icon tiles (see props) with size, wide, badge and ghost options.
new_assets.implementation: One function tile(ctx, x, y, kind, {size, wide, badge, ghost, t}): paper square with a tapering brush border, icon drawn from simple shapes in the palette (tent = triangle with a flap; rug = two rolled rects; room = arch, door, window; house = cracked wall, crooked door; school = arched front and slate; garden = Library tree at s 0.2 plus a fountain arc; cities = domes, a minaret, round wall or palms and boats; army = five spearmen as capsule bodies with dot heads and a banner; crowd = rows of dot heads). Animals use the planned cow, sheep and camel at small scale if they exist by then, otherwise simple side-view silhouettes; the lion is the Library lion at s 0.26. ghost: alpha 0.45 and a dashed border.

new_assets.name: claimPile
new_assets.description: A wobbling stack of tiles tied to the bag by a three-bubble trail: add tiles on cue times, sway, droop, collapse.
new_assets.implementation: pile(ctx, t, {side, tiles: [[t0, kind, opts]...], x0, y0, cols, size}): each tile scales in with settleTo from its cue time and sits on a 2-column grid growing upward; the whole pile rotates about its base by swing() restarted at every new tile; landSquash runs down the rows with stagger; collapse(t0) lets every tile fall with fallY and a seeded spin, then pop. The trail is three circles from the bag mouth to the pile base.

new_assets.name: crowdDots
new_assets.description: Dozens of tiny heads (dot with two eye dots, optional raised hand) for thousands of witnesses and the queue in the judge's balloon.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded positions from K.rng in a region; each head pops at t0 + i * 0.02; hand is a 2 px line raised on a cue; walking variant moves along a line with phase-offset bob.

new_assets.name: bagFood (bread, cheese, olives, lemon)
new_assets.description: The four real contents of the bag, small and plain.
new_assets.implementation: Four tiny functions from circles, an ellipse and a wedge path with black outlines and dot shading; each takes x, y, s, rot.

new_assets.name: diwan
new_assets.description: Low couch with rolled arm, pillow, striped cushions and a blanket overlay for a lying figure.
new_assets.implementation: Rect base with turned feet, seat line 48 above the base, rolled arm as a circle plus rect at the left; blanket is a separate rounded quad drawn after the lying person with a bump that follows the body (and breathe()).

new_assets.name: purse
new_assets.implementation: Rounded pouch in red with a yellow cord and three coin discs at the mouth; glints as 4-point stars on cue.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (judge)
new_assets.description: A judge preset: the physician figure with a navy robe, a large white turban that can tilt and roll off, age 0.8.
new_assets.implementation: Add 'judge' to the COSTUME table (copy physician, pal navy robe, turban scale 1.2) plus an opt-in field turbanTilt (radians) and turbanOff (draws no headwear so the scene can draw the rolling turban).

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: The planned round balloon with one icon and a tail to the speaker (scroll, laughing face, loaf, question mark).
new_assets.implementation: Circle or cloud() with a tail triangle; inside(c) callback draws the icon; pops in with settleTo.

new_assets.name: worryScribble
new_assets.description: A small black scribble cloud over a worried head that can pulse, shrink and burst.
new_assets.implementation: Twelve seeded looping strokes (K.rng) inside a 110 px blob, redrawn with a slow K.noise wobble; scale and alpha fields; burst = strokes fly out as dots.

new_assets.name: person laugh
new_assets.description: The planned laugh pose: head back, mouth wide, rocking, eyes squeezed.
new_assets.implementation: A helper laugh(t, t0, amp) returning {tip, talk, lid, sq} cycling at 2.5 Hz with decay; works seated.

new_assets.name: taleZoom
new_assets.description: Enter and leave a told story through the teller's thought cloud growing to fill the panel.
new_assets.implementation: thoughtCloud with w and h animated from 300 to 4000 over 0.75 s (ease-in), fill matched to the next scene's sky; the scene switch happens when the cloud covers the panel; reversed for the return.

owner_questions: The rival is shown as a neutral, burly villager variant and labelled A KURDISH STRANGER as in the script (default); say if you prefer the label A STRANGER.
Invented comic lettering (YOINK!, MINE!, EVEN BIGGER!, ENOUGH!, OPEN IT!, THAT'S ALL!, FALSE!, HA HA HA!, Z z z) and labels are added as visual lettering only (default: keep).
Addition beyond the script: the Caliph yawns at the gift and is asleep and smiling in the last shot, paying off his sleepless night (default: keep).

The English subtitles of paragraphs 4 and 7 contain an em dash; the plan keeps the script verbatim and the default is to show a comma in its place on screen, because the series rule forbids dashes in on-screen text.
The "sensible things" at 56-58 s are not named in the script; the plan shows a cup, a comb and a folded cloth (default: keep these generic items).
Paragraph 5 was removed from the audio, so the film goes straight from Ali's list to the judge losing patience with no bridging picture invented (default).

After the reveal the food goes back into the bag under the cut at 136.22, so Ali throws a tied, full bag at his rival's feet (default); the alternative is to leave the food on the stool and throw the empty bag.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world 1000 x 1230, ground y 900; in courtRoom the bag stool stands in the foreground at floor y 1000 and the claimants at y 930.
